name: @burdenoff/mcp-manufacturedops

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_login
tools.description: Start the device code login flow. Returns a verification URL and user code immediately (non-blocking). The user must open the URL in a browser and enter the code, then call vibecontrols_auth_complete to finish.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_complete
tools.description: Check if the user has completed the device code authorization in their browser. Call this after the user has opened the verification URL and entered the code from vibecontrols_auth_login. Returns "pending" if not yet authorized, "authenticated" on success.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_select_workspace
tools.description: Select a workspace after login (when multiple workspaces are available). Issues a workspace-scoped token.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces available to the authenticated user.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_status
tools.description: Show current authentication status including method, token expiration, workspace info, and pending login state.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_logout
tools.description: Log out and clear all stored authentication tokens.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_sign_up
tools.description: Register a new account via email/username/password and immediately sign in. Persists access + refresh tokens. Returns { user, accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }.

email.description: Email address for the new account

password.description: Password (caller is responsible for strength policy)

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in with username + password (server-side credential flow, distinct from the device-code `auth_login`). Persists access + refresh tokens. Returns { user, accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_refresh_token
tools.description: Exchange the stored refreshToken for a fresh access + refresh pair. The gql client auto-refreshes when tokens are near expiry; use this tool only when you need to force a refresh now. Persists new tokens. Returns the new { accessToken, expiresIn }.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_authenticate_app
tools.description: Machine-to-machine auth via the `authenticateApp` GraphQL mutation. Pass an OAuth app client_id + client_secret (and optional scopes) to receive an access token; persists token for subsequent calls. Returns { accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, scopes }.

clientSecret.description: OAuth app clientSecret (shown only once on app creation)

scopes.description: Optional list of scope strings to request

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_login_with_api_key
tools.description: Authenticate with a pre-issued API key (headless service mode). The key is stored locally and sent as `X-API-Key` on every gateway request; no network call is made by this tool. Use auth_status to verify. Returns { status: "authenticated", method: "api_key" }.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_login_with_client_credentials
tools.description: OAuth2 client_credentials grant (REST against oidcIssuer/token). Equivalent to auth_authenticate_app but uses the OIDC token endpoint instead of the GraphQL mutation; prefer auth_authenticate_app inside the platform. Persists the issued token. Returns { accessToken, expiresIn, scopes }.

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_profile_get
tools.description: Show the current authenticated user (id, email, name, role, status).

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_profile_update
tools.description: Update the current user profile (any subset of fields).

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_sessions_list
tools.description: List active sessions for the current user (browser/device sessions).

tools.name: manufacturedops_auth_sessions_revoke
tools.description: Revoke (sign out) a single session by id.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_apps_versions_create
tools.description: Create a new version for an application.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_apps_webhooks_list
tools.description: List webhooks attached to an application (live global `Query.webhooks(applicationId)`).

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_apps_webhooks_add
tools.description: Add a webhook to an application. The live mutation takes `applicationId` as a top-level argument plus `input: CreateWebhookInput!`. The result is `WebhookCreated { webhook { ... } }` (the type itself has no `id`).

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_apps_webhooks_remove
tools.description: Remove a webhook by ID. Live mutation returns Boolean! (no selection set).

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_apps_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for an application over a period.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_revenue
tools.description: Get revenue summary for an organization. [intentionally stubbed: `Query.organizationRevenue` (and any `revenue` field on `organization` / `app`) was removed from the alpha supergraph. Use `_billing_invoices_list`, `_billing_subscriptions_list` instead.]

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_admin_reviews_list
tools.description: List applications in the admin review queue. Live query is `appReviews(applicationId, status, limit, offset)` (the unscoped `adminReviews` field was removed). `applicationId` is required, `status` filters the connection server-side, and pagination uses `limit` + `offset` (NOT `first`/`after`).

applicationId.description: Application ID to scope the review queue to

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_admin_reviews_approve
tools.description: Approve a pending application.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_admin_reviews_reject
tools.description: Reject a pending application.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_api_keys_list
tools.description: List API keys for an application. Live query is `appApiKeys(appId: ID!)`.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_api_keys_create
tools.description: Mint a new API key via `generateAPIKey(input: GenerateAPIKeyInput!)` (live auth mutation). Returns the full key including the one-time-visible `apiKey`/`apiSecret`.

scopes.description: Scope identifiers granted to the key — REQUIRED on the live `GenerateAPIKeyInput.scope`

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_api_keys_revoke
tools.description: Revoke an API key via `revokeAPIKey(keyId: String!)` (live global mutation, returns Boolean!).

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_oauth_list
tools.description: List OAuth 2.0 clients registered for a devportal application. [intentionally stubbed: `Query.oauthClients(applicationId)` no longer exists on the alpha supergraph, and `app(id)` does not expose a nested `oauthClients` field either. Use `_auth_current_user_apps` instead.]

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_oauth_create
tools.description: Register a new OAuth 2.0 client for an application. [intentionally stubbed: `Mutation.createOAuthClient` (and `CreateOAuthClientInput`) have been removed from the alpha supergraph. Use `_auth_current_user_apps` (read-only on alpha) instead.]

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_oauth_delete
tools.description: Delete an OAuth 2.0 client by ID. [intentionally stubbed: `Mutation.deleteOAuthClient` has been removed from the alpha supergraph (no successor field). Use `_auth_*` surface for current OAuth flows instead.]

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_delegations_list
tools.description: List workspace delegations issued to applications. Live impl proxies through the global `Query.currentUserDelegations` (calls scoped to the caller). Note: in-scope filtering by application/workspace is not supported on the live schema — pass `first` to paginate.

first.description: Page size (default 50). Filter args from the old `delegations(...)` were dropped.

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_delegations_create
tools.description: Grant a workspace delegation to an application. Live impl is `grantDelegation(input: GrantDelegationInput!)` (renamed from `CreateDelegationInput`); `appId` replaces `applicationId`. The grant is implicitly to the calling actor — `GrantDelegationInput` does NOT take a `userId`.

applicationId.description: Application ID receiving the delegation (forwarded as `appId`)

scopes.description: Scope identifiers granted to the application — REQUIRED on the live GrantDelegationInput

workspaceIds.description: Optional list of workspace IDs scoping the delegation (forwarded as `workspaceIds`)

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp (DateTime scalar — must be a full ISO 8601 instant, not a date)

tools.name: manufacturedops_devportal_delegations_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a workspace delegation via `revokeDelegation(id: ID!)` (live schema, returns Boolean!; no selection set).

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.
